name: C11_PI_FOREST_OR_LIST3_TERMINAL_GATE_V1

frozen_terminal_stack.input: After fixing one PI assignment (y,y')=(gamma,delta), exact boundary propagation, and only already-frozen/source-faithful normalization, consider each connected residual component C with exact current lists.

case_1.label: L3_READY
case_1.condition: There exists c in [4] absent from every list in C.

case_2.label: FOREST_LIST_READY
case_2.condition: C is a forest, regardless of whether its list union is [4].

case_3.label: CYCLIC_FULL_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL
case_3.condition: C is connected, not contradiction, not L3_READY, and not a forest.
case_3.receipt: Return exact graph/lists and an explicit cycle certificate.

universal_target: Determine whether every authoritative C11 PI-route residual component falls into L3_READY or FOREST_LIST_READY.
exact_algorithm_if_universal: For each survivor pair and each of four PI assignments, apply exact frozen propagation/preprocessing.
Factor the undecided graph into connected components with all fixed-boundary restrictions encoded in lists.
For each component first test global missing color; if yes, use List-3.
Otherwise test acyclicity in linear time; if forest, use arbitrary-list forest terminal.
If every component is solved, reconstruct the branch coloring; the branch bit q_{gamma,delta} is computed polynomially.
Repeat for four assignments and all polynomially enumerable survivor pairs.

T1_UNIVERSAL_FOREST_OR_L3_COLLAPSE.label: T1_UNIVERSAL_FOREST_OR_L3_COLLAPSE
pass_requires: A proof from frozen authoritative-core hypotheses that every residual component after every authoritative pair/PI assignment is either L3_READY or FOREST_LIST_READY.
A polynomial graph-only procedure implementing the classification and corresponding solver calls.
Exact reconstruction and total polynomial budget.
No extension oracle and no general P7-free 4-color solver.
consequence_ceiling: All four PI bits are polynomially computable.
D1_PI_POLY_DISCOVERABLE may be promoted with exact binding.
The <=16 Pi-mask quotient becomes polynomially discoverable.
P3_EXACT_PAIR_QUOTIENT may then be promoted with a separate exact binding receipt.

T2_CYCLIC_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL.label: T2_CYCLIC_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL
T2_CYCLIC_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL.condition: A concrete authoritative residual component C survives exact frozen preprocessing with no globally missing color and C contains a cycle.
certificate: upstream C11 survivor pair and PI assignment
explicit simple cycle vertex/edge sequence in C
proof C is not a forest
proof no additional already-frozen deterministic preprocessing applies
T2_CYCLIC_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL.interpretation: Refutes universality only of the frozen L3-or-forest terminal stack. No hardness or lower-bound conclusion.

T3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.label: T3_GATE_UNRESOLVED
T3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.condition: Neither universal T1 proof nor complete T2 authoritative certificate is established.

B2_reinterpretation.component: b3-a0-a1-b2 with the exact frozen lists.
B2_reinterpretation.consequence: The B2 witness proves bd_L3(C)>1 relative to the old L3-backdoor stack, but is no longer an obstruction to polynomial PI-bit computation under the enlarged terminal library.

controls.list3_control: Retain canonical/global-missing-color controls from the D2 PI-discovery gate.

cyclic_negative_control.required_property: Provide a synthetic connected cyclic list-instance with union of lists [4] so the checker cannot classify every non-L3 component as forest.

anti_cheat: Do not branch on one or two vertices in this gate.
Acyclicity must be verified from the residual graph, not inferred from a small fixture.
Forest list-colorability must use exact propagated lists including all fixed-boundary restrictions.
B2's failure of 1-L3 does not count as T2 because its interaction graph is acyclic.
Finite testing alone cannot establish T1.
A T2 cycle certificate does not imply hardness.
next_action: Separate authorization required. Audit only the frozen L3-or-forest terminal stack and stop at T1/T2/T3.
